messages:
omar_fin: Alert  NorthHarbor invoice INV-2109 came in with PO-7721 but the PO is for 'NorthAmerica-Platform' while invoice header says 'EMEA-Sales'. System routed to Sales approvers and AP blocked due to entity mismatch. Can procurement confirm intended entity?
jia_procure: Looking. PO-7721 was issued by Sales Ops for a marketing campaign (entity: EMEA-Sales). How did NS show NorthAmerica-Platform?
ellie_ap: The invoice file show billing address UK and VAT GB12345, currency GBP. But the PO in our ERP is tied to NA legal entity (US-EIN). We can't match for payment.
mike_sales: We definitely requested PO-7721 under EMEA budget. Maybe PO numbering duplicated across entities. @jia_procure any chance someone used the wrong legal_code when creating the PO?
jia_procure: Possible. Our PO generator should include entity prefix but older templates allowed manual override. I'll pull the PO audit.
vendor-bot: NorthHarbor (billing@northharbor.co.uk) uploaded invoice INV-2109 (PDF). PDF shows: "PO: 7721" and reference "Campaign Q3 EMEA". Attachment: https://files.example.com/northharbor/INV-2109.pdf
omar_fin: Also the invoice total 9,750.00 GBP converted to USD 12,430.50 on our system. Exchange rate applied looks older (2025-07-29). Can treasury confirm FX used? We need correct conversion for GL.
finance-bot: Automation: Invoice auto-coded to "uncleared_entity_mismatch". Routing: Sales-approvals (due to PO->Sales team), AP hold placed.
jia_procure: Audit: PO-7721 created 2025-07-18 by user 'mike_sales' under template 'sales-emea' but approver changed the legal_entity field to 'NA-Platform' during finalization (likely by mistake). I'll flag PO for edit history and create corrective PO if needed.
mike_sales: That was me, I remember switching cost center last minute. Sorry — didn't realize legal entity field flipped.
ellie_ap: OK we need one of two paths: 1) Vendor reissue invoice with PO showing entity id matching our NA PO, or 2) Procurement creates a mirrored PO under EMEA and AP does a PO swap/match. Which is faster?
jia_procure: Creating mirrored PO (PO-7721-EMEA) and mapping to original should be faster. But we need written vendor consent to accept the mirrored PO without re-issuance. I'll reach out.
omar_fin: Meanwhile, hold payment and don't schedule run. Also need to prevent duplicate payment if we mirror the PO. Tag invoice with 'mirror-in-progress'.
finance-bot: Task created: T-7894  "create mirrored PO and vendor confirmation". Assigned to jia_procure.
vendor-bot: Message sent to vendor contact (billing@northharbor.co.uk): "Please confirm you accept PO reference change to PO-7721-EMEA or reissue invoice referencing PO-7721-EMEA. Reply with confirmation to avoid payment delay"
mike_sales: I can confirm verbally with vendor contact — they usually reply quickly. Pinged my account rep.
vendor-bot: Vendor replied: "Confirmed. We accept PO reference PO-7721-EMEA. No reissue needed. Please confirm when AP updates records."
ellie_ap: Great. Jia, please provide the mirrored PO ID and indicate mapping so I can clear the entity mismatch. Also provide updated FX rate to use (treasury needed).
jia_procure: Mirrored PO created: PO-7721-EMEA. Mapping note added: original_po=7721 (NA-Platform), mirrored_for_invoice=PO-7721-EMEA. Comment: vendor consent received 2025-08-22.
finance-bot: Treasury FX check: latest rate GBP->USD (2025-08-22) 1.2765. Finance automation suggests revaluate to USD 12,439.88. Please confirm.
omar_fin: Use treasury-provided rate. Update GL > code 5402 (marketing services) and mark invoice ready for approver route to Finance-Payables.
ellie_ap: Updated invoice record: entity set to EMEA-Sales, PO matched to PO-7721-EMEA, currency conversion applied USD 12,439.88, payment_hold:false (removed). Moving to payments queue.
mike_sales: Thanks team. Note for process: procurement should lock legal_entity on PO templates to prevent manual flips.
jia_procure: Agreed. I'll raise change request to disable free-edit of legal_entity on PO creation template.
omar_fin: Closing loop: invoice approved and scheduled for next payment run. Opening a small follow-up ticket for procurement template fix. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
